findings.summary: WebSocket dropped all incoming frames after authentication ('if (authorized) return;'). Fixed with duplex command dispatcher.
Doctors and administrators had no visibility into who opened the same visit. Fixed with passive SoftPresenceIndicator without modal locks.
Client audit logs were only kept in ephemeral memory and discarded on tab refresh. Fixed with persistent localStorage buffer and auto-flush.
Math.random was used in clinical mesh identifiers (callId, transferId, p2p messageId). Fixed with cryptographic UUIDv7.
